Container.Name: hbook-suwayomi
Container.Overview: The extension engine for hbook: it runs Mihon/Tachiyomi extensions so hbook can search, follow and download from them. You never open it yourself; hbook's Admin, Sources tab is where you add repositories and install extensions. Install hbook first. Choose a password for the engine below (AUTH_PASSWORD): its port is on your network, so it asks for one. Before the first start, open the Unraid terminal and run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/hbook-suwayomi and then chown 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/hbook-suwayomi (the engine runs as user 1000 and cannot write to a folder that belongs to root). It takes a minute or two to start the first time. Then, on the hbook container, set SUWAYOMI_URL to http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4567, SUWAYOMI_USERNAME to the user name below (hbook unless you changed it) and SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD to the password you chose, and apply. It uses 1 to 1.5 GB of memory while it runs and is capped at 2 GB. MangaDex and sites you add by address work in hbook without it. To remove it, stop it and clear SUWAYOMI_URL on hbook; keep its appdata folder if you might come back, because it holds the links for every series you added through an extension.
Container.Requires: hbook (the hbook template). A FlareSolverr for sites behind Cloudflare is recommended: the same one hbook uses.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: The port hbook talks to: SUWAYOMI_URL is http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4567. Its own web page is off, and the user name and password below guard it.

Config.Name: Engine data
Config.Description: Installed extensions, and the links for every series added through them. Never delete it. It is not in hbook's nightly backup: back it up with your appdata. Must belong to user 1000 (see the overview).

Config.Name: FLARESOLVERR_URL
Config.Description: The same FlareSolverr address as hbook's FLARESOLVERR_URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191. Without it, extension sources behind Cloudflare fail with Cloudflare bypass currently disabled.

Config.Name: FLARESOLVERR_ENABLED
Config.Description: Let the engine use that FlareSolverr. It has no browser of its own.

Config.Name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
Config.Description: The engine's heap cap, the same as the desktop app's. Raise it only if the engine's log says java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space, and raise the memory limit in Extra Parameters by the same amount: keep that limit at least 1.25 GB above this.

Config.Name: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX
Config.Description: Keep 2. The C library otherwise gives the engine up to eight memory pools per CPU core, and what one thread frees stays in its own pool: with 2 the engine holds about 120 MB less.

Config.Name: AUTO_DOWNLOAD_CHAPTERS
Config.Description: Keep false: hbook does the downloading and owns the library. True would fill this folder with a second, unmanaged copy.

Config.Name: WEB_UI_ENABLED
Config.Description: The engine's own web page. Off: hbook is the interface.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the engine's logs.

Config.Name: AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: basic_auth: the engine's port asks for the user name and password below, which hbook sends as SUWAYOMI_USERNAME and SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD. Leave it on: the port is on your network.

Config.Name: AUTH_USERNAME
Config.Description: The engine's user name. Set the same on the hbook container as SUWAYOMI_USERNAME.

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Choose a password for the engine, and set the same on the hbook container as SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD.
